provenance.source_title: Your Life After Marrying Into a Billionaire Family

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（温情版：替你预演一生的旁白）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你人生档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用短句与具体数字把你逐级送上阶层爬梯；对财富不惊叹、对穷酸不怜悯，体量差全部交给同单位数字对照；判词简短温柔但分量不减，像一位知道结局的老朋友在你耳边预演
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：不是「给你讲一个童话」，而是「这就是你将过的人生」，亲密到像在替你回忆
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自细节的可信（圈层规则、考验机制、家族打法）与预言式的确定语气

tone_profile.certainty_style: 全部用确定语气陈述（You will / It is），判词用最小单位与单字句独立落下；不写模糊感慨

rhythm_rules.rule: 连续短句推进（平均8.5词，短句占52%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持档案宣读式的宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 阶层差一律用同单位数字对照（$4,000戒指 vs 10,000个）
情绪判词用最小单位或单字句独立落下（An inch is everything. / She was.）
开场意象在中后段逐一召回（咖啡店/便宜意面/修空调的父亲）
rhythm_rules.function: 用复现制造时间纵深与主题回扣

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 判词用单句成段（Later is the family curse.）
主题重锤用单字句收尾（She was.）
章节卡后接年龄/处境定格（You are 34 years old and...）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level five, the apprentice.）
时间跳转声明（Two years pass faster than you expect. / Years pass the way years do.）
计划外事件转折（Then the honeymoon ends and real life begins.）
循环回收（Somewhere out there, a young man is sitting across from a woman...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅开场恋爱段与体量差段落一两处
placement_rules: 仆人叫你 sir 你每次都一缩的阶级错位小幽默
「这感觉维持了约1周」式幸福限时器
avoid_rules: 不嘲笑任何一方的出身
病重、葬礼与托付段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [身份]. You are [年龄] years old.
Your car has over 100,000 miles on it. The check engine light has been on for a year.
language_patterns.purpose: 用被忽略的小毛病写经济层

language_patterns.formula: She orders the cheapest pasta... You don't understand why until later. She is being kind.
you type her last name into a search bar. Your stomach drops straight through the floor.
language_patterns.purpose: 用日常动作+身体反应写真相时刻

language_patterns.formula: The ring costs $4,000... her father could buy 10,000 of them and not notice.
language_patterns.purpose: 用同一商品两种购买力写阶层差

language_patterns.formula: You feel like the richest man who ever lived. That feeling lasts about 1 week.
language_patterns.purpose: 在情绪最高点立刻给倒计时

language_patterns.formula: The house is not a house. It is a compound with wings and a name.
Every dinner is a job interview you never applied for.
language_patterns.purpose: 把日常场景重命名为非自愿考核

language_patterns.formula: The language has no actual words. It is made of glances and silences and who gets seated where.
You earn an inch of his trust. An inch is everything.
language_patterns.purpose: 用最小单位放大进展的重量

language_patterns.formula: You use it to protect the family. That distinction earns you everything.
language_patterns.purpose: 把成败归因到资源的用法之别

language_patterns.formula: None of the billionaires came to a working man's funeral.
language_patterns.purpose: 只写谁没来，让缺席下判词

language_patterns.formula: blood built this empire, but blood will not keep it standing.
language_patterns.purpose: 用同一词承担建与毁写传承悖论

language_patterns.formula: Everything else was just weather. The fortune was never the prize. She was.
language_patterns.purpose: 给一生财富降级并用单字句收束

language_patterns.formula: Somewhere out there, a young man is sitting across from a woman in a coffee shop.

preferred_traits: 可拍照的具体物件（check engine light、cheap pasta、$4,000 ring、locket 式小物）
同单位数字对照（$52,000 vs 10 digits、$4,000 vs 10,000）
圈层机制名词的通俗化（pre-nup、equity、leverage、the board）
avoid_traits: 操作指南式的权斗细节

forbidden_style.rule: 情绪必须用画面、数字与事实承载，禁止形容词直给
病重、葬礼与托付段落绝对不用幽默
主题落点必须在人不在钱，禁止拜金式收束
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止把阶层跃迁写成无代价童话

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
